column1: # One row per parity surface. Edit this file to add surfaces or documentation
# sources; nothing else needs to change. Column order:
#   surface id  title  doc slugs (comma separated, may be empty)  action id prefixes (comma separated, may be empty)
# fetched and its HTTP status recorded, so a slug that Goes 404 is reported as a
# gap instead of failing silently. One row can name several slugs; all of them
# Action prefixes match against `actions-labeled.tsv` (harvested from the
# installed bundle) so each surface spec arrives preloaded with the real action
